titulo: Your channel, in the right order
hero_alt: An organized desk with an open planning notebook, a calendar, and a phone standing upright.
lead: You’ve seen the whole pipeline. Now put the pieces together in the order they depend on one another: the reel on paper, the rules, the source material, the checked script, the schedule, and the week with a gate. Generate your dated plan, then return to the training overview to see how this step builds on the other three.
objetivo: leave with a dated plan for the 7 exercises in step 4 and know how to say, at each stage, what proves it’s done.

secoes.sub: Click each step. Each one uses what came before.

nos.detalhe: The reel in 7 steps, based on a plan rated 7 or higher. Proof: you can read it in under 45 s, and the first line hooks you.
canais.md and regras.md. Proof: 5 references, each with a one-line criterion, and the required disclaimer written out.
base.md from a transcribed video. Proof: confere.py prints only OK.
The 60 s script requested from the agent. Proof: every number is in the source material, and the gate checklist is checked off.
The timer or cron schedule written down. Proof: the next round is listed, and you know what happens on a day with no topic.
A week approving each video, with rejections turned into rules. Proof: 3 days in a row without rejecting one.

secoes.legenda: The extra challenge (3 videos for the same audience, lesson 6) comes in when E4 is done. It doesn’t depend on the schedule.

secoes.sub: Choose a start date and how much time you have each week. The plan accounts for exercises that require real days of use.

txt.travou: ## What I rejected and the rule I created

itens.texto: Every number on screen has a source, the video, and the exact excerpt. If it doesn’t, it doesn’t go in.
The plan, text, and fact check come before the avatar and render. The gate goes where the spending starts.
The schedule runs on its own, but each rejection from you becomes a line in regras.md. The gate only comes down when rejections stop.

One question for each piece of the pipeline.

perguntas.p: Which of these sequences respects the dependencies between the pieces?
opcoes: Rules → source → reviewed script → schedule → week with a gate.
Week with a gate → rules → source.
perguntas.explica: The source depends on the references and rules; the script depends on the source; the schedule only makes sense with the reviewed script; the gate comes last, with the schedule running.

perguntas.p: What proves that your sourced base is ready?
opcoes: The checker finds every passage in the transcript (only OK).
The agent said it looks good.
perguntas.explica: Done when it’s verifiable: the script searches for each passage in the transcript. Your opinion or the agent’s isn’t proof.

perguntas.p: Where does the gate protect the most money and time?
opcoes: Before the avatar and render, which cost money and can’t be undone.
perguntas.explica: In promoavatar, the first gate protects the avatar expense, and the second protects the render expense. The text is the cheap part to get wrong.
